lead: The runtime source documents firmware-dependent kernel import failures before startup logging. Its documented null-address failure is not the same as the observed instruction pointer, so the cause is unconfirmed.

additional_source_evidence.recorded_source_revision_build_script: At ce289425, tools/build_native.sh explicitly links native libkernel.so and excludes other libkernel stub variants, addressing the documented 13.60 null-import failure.
additional_source_evidence.limit: This source inspection does not prove the exact link inputs of the installed binary and does not explain the reported nonzero SIGSYS instruction pointer. No FAKE78004 title log was present.

next_step: After restarting Codex to load the updated REA server, inspect the actual crashing launcher and map the crash addresses; corroborate any proposed correction with an isolated console test.
